newsitem.title: USA: Saf T Lok names John Gardner as president.
newsitem.headline: Saf T Lok names John Gardner as president.

text.p: Saf T Lok Inc said on Tuesday John Gardner had been named as its president and chief executive officer, succeeding the company's founder, Frank Brooks, who served in those positions while a replacement was found.
Brooks will continue to serve as the company's chairman, the company said in a statement.
Gardner, 61, previously served as chief executive and co-founder at Central Florida Innovation Corp, a public/private venture sponsored by the state to promote economic development, the company said.
Gardner also worked at McDonnell Douglas, where he served as vice president and general manager of the Laser and Electronics Systems Division, it said.

Gardner said his first priority was "to secure adequate funding so as to capitalize on the many marketing opportunities and provide sufficient working capital. I also anticipate expanding management talent in the key areas of marketing and finance," he said.
Saf T Lok manufactures and distributes the patented "quick click" locking device, Saf T Lok for handguns.
